description: Implementation of a Google Cloud Storage (GCS) cache with synchronous and asynchronous methods for setting, getting, and managing cache entries, including HTTP request handling and integration with GCS buckets.

classes.name: GCSCache
classes.description: A cache class that interacts with Google Cloud Storage, supporting both sync and async operations for cache management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes GCSCache with optional bucket name, service account path, and GCS path, setting up HTTP clients.

methods.name: _construct_headers
methods.description: Constructs request headers for GCS API requests based on bucket and service account info.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Stores a cache entry in GCS synchronously.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Stores a cache entry in GCS asynchronously.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry from GCS synchronously.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry from GCS asynchronously.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Placeholder for disconnecting or cleanup logic.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Performs batch asynchronous cache set operations.
